- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:43-52 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The acceptance-pattern regex set is written so the intended `complete when` phrase will not match.
  WHY: The reviewer says the escaped pattern text prevents the signal from recognizing acceptance-style wording.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:116-117 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `_has_no_acceptance` can miss acceptance-style text because it only does a generic pattern search.
  WHY: The reviewer says the current checks are not anchored tightly enough, so acceptance phrases can slip through.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:129-137 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The log-dump detector's prefix regex will not match the intended bracketed log lines.
  WHY: The reviewer says the first regex component is escaped incorrectly, so lines like `[ERROR] ...` are missed.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:80-99 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The stdin reader uses a thread/shared-dict pattern that can race with the join timeout.
  WHY: The reviewer says the main thread can observe `result["data"]` before the reader thread finishes, producing partial or nondeterministic reads.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:80-99 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Exceptions from the stdin reader are not surfaced deterministically before the caller proceeds.
  WHY: The reviewer says the error is stored in shared state and may not be raised before the read times out or returns partial data.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:107-110 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Query-string URLs can suppress `no_ask` because the signal rejects any body containing `?`.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: moonshot labeled NIT and x-ai_grok labeled MAJOR; use HIGH.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:121 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `link_only` heuristic uses the full trimmed-body length and can miss long single-URL bodies.
  WHY: The reviewer says the code checks total length instead of the URL-free remainder, so long URLs are not flagged.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:131-135 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: A body containing only a long URL may fail `link_only` because the heuristic only checks `len(trimmed) < 50`.
  WHY: The reviewer says long single-URL bodies can exceed the threshold even when they contain no meaningful text.
- scripts/clarify_informal_detect.py:158 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `main()` catches `Exception` broadly at the top level.
  WHY: The reviewer says this boundary is overly permissive and can mask termination behavior under some invocation patterns.
- tests/test_clarify_informal_detect.py:15 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The focused test module depends on a writable temp directory that is unavailable in the current workspace.
  WHY: The reviewer says one test always fails with "No usable temporary directory," so the suite cannot run cleanly here.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
